notes.title: UI Update
notes.notes:
Changes:
*in game Ui updated! now much prettier 
*opening credits fixed
*Adjustments made to main menu (based on feed back) to make it easier to navigate
*now you can check out settings on main menu for UI explanations and action key list
*Crosshairs added upon popular request (I included an ammo count attached as well) crosshairs are toggleable for those who enjoyed the spray and pray game play
*Load screens between levels!
*Bug that hangs game up on reload of last level should now be fixed
*Many other small tweaks and fixes

Enjoy and thanks to everyone once again for the great feed back! keep it coming and I will do my best to continue tailoring Metal golem to the players.
I already have a couple more things planned, but if there is anything you'd love to see in the game please feel free to visit our Facebook page and or message me. I love to hear from you guys
once again thank you and have fun!
~Nikk
